summary.en: Conviction is an early-stage AI-focused venture firm founded in 2022 by Sarah Guo (ex-Greylock) in San Francisco. It launched with a $101M inaugural fund and raised a $230M Fund II in 2025, backing AI-native 'Software 3.0' companies including Mistral, Cognition, Harvey and Sierra.

summary.en: Construct Capital is a Washington, D.C.-based early-stage VC firm founded in 2020 by Dayna Grayson (ex-NEA) and Rachel Holt (ex-Uber) to back robotics, AI and automation startups rebuilding 'Foundational Industries' (manufacturing, logistics, defense, energy). It manages $750M AUM across three funds, including a $300M Fund III closed in 2025.

summary.en: Renegade Partners is a Bay Area VC firm founded by Renata Quintini (ex-Lux, ex-Felicis) and Roseanne Wincek (ex-IVP). It rolled out a $100M debut fund in 2021 and closed a $128M Fund II in 2024, focusing on the 'supercritical' Series A–B stage between product-market fit and growth, with checks up to $10M.

summary.en: Gold House Ventures is the venture arm of nonprofit collective Gold House, launching a $30M fund in April 2022 led by GPs Bing Chen, Eric Feng (ex-Kleiner Perkins) and Megan Ruan. It writes $50K–$250K checks alongside other VCs into startups led by founders of Asian and Pacific Islander descent, and runs the Gold Rush accelerator ($100K for 5%).

strategy.thesis: Designed to help a small number of founders maximize the power of narrative — leveraging lessons from The Generalist publication to help companies build network, distribution and storytelling.

summary.en: Generalist Capital is a solo-GP fund founded in 2022 by Mario Gabriele, author of The Generalist newsletter. The $12.25M Fund I (backed by a16z's Marc Andreessen and Chris Dixon, Multicoin, DCG, Polygon and others) is designed to help a small set of founders master narrative, network and distribution.
